name: River discharge

source.name: Copernicus GloFAS historical hydrological data
source.limitations: GloFAS v4 is uncalibrated in most basins of the deployment area, so absolute discharge can differ substantially from gauged values; treat readings as relative anomalies and temporal patterns. Values describe the 0.05° river-network cell, not a specific gauge, and recent days use ERA5T intermediate forcing that is revised when consolidated ERA5 arrives.

description: Daily average river discharge from the Copernicus Global Flood Awareness System (GloFAS), using consolidated ERA5 reanalysis where available and ERA5T intermediate data at the recent edge.

destinations.name: River discharge
destinations.description: Daily average river discharge in m³/s on the 0.05° GloFAS river network.
